title: Egg in a Hole French Toast Grilled Cheese
description: Grilled cheese is dipped in French toast batter, a hole is cut in the center, and is cooked with an egg in the hole in this brunch sandwich.

steps.text: Whisk half-and-half, 1 egg, sugar, cinnamon, and salt together in a bowl until batter is smooth.

Place 2 bread slices on a work surface and top each with 1 slice American cheese, 1 slice Cheddar cheese, and crumbled bacon. Top each with a second piece of bread, making a sandwich. Cut a 2-inch hole in the center of each sandwich using a biscuit cutter or 2-inch wide glass.
Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, tilting the skillet to cover entire surface with butter. Dip both sandwich rings and cut-out holes in the batter until evenly coated.

Place the dipped sandwich rings and cut-out holes in the melted butter in the skillet. Immediately crack an egg into the hole of each ring. Cook until egg white is set, bread is golden brown, and cheese is softly melted, about 2 minutes per side.

video.description: What happens when you combine your 3 favorite things in one sandwich? The ultimate breakfast sandwich to eat at any hour of the day! First, make a sandwich as if you’re just making grilled cheese: white bread filled with American and cheddar cheeses and—why not?—some crumbled bacon. Then use a biscuit cutter to cut a hole from each sandwich. Melt some butter in your pan and meanwhile dip your sandwich (and its center) in a sweet French toast batter of eggs, half-n-half, vanilla, cinnamon, sugar and salt. Add to the pan and break an egg into each ring, then cook until egg is set and cheese is melted.
